_help: Optional per-page overrides, keyed by file name without .html. Any field you leave out is read from the page itself (its <title> and <meta name="description">). Set hidden: true to keep a page off the home page while its link still works. Lower order numbers show first.

cleveland-rental-atlas.description: Interactive ZIP-code map of Cleveland and Cuyahoga County for rental investors: prices, rents, CMHA Section 8 payment standards, days on market, local rules, and what BiggerPockets and Reddit investors say.

section-8-yield-finder.description: Every US ZIP's 3-bedroom Section 8 voucher rent set against what a 3-bedroom home costs there. Filter, compare metros and run the numbers on a deal.
